item.title: Identity Politics (Ep. 164): State of the Right
item.description: A week from today will be the one year anniversary of the assassination of Charlie Kirk. In the year since, the American Right seems to have totally fractured. The Trump Administration has scored some successes against antifa, but its coalition is splintering. Part of this is due to the Administration's missteps. However, part of it is due to our own vanguard, which is desperate to opt out of conflict, make a separate peace, and take refuge in "safe edgy" conspiracy theories that keep you out of trouble.

item.title: Identity Politics (Ep. 163): Anarcho-Tyranny: Punishing the Innocent (w/ Thomas Corbett-Dillon)
item.description: Law is dead, the Regime has lost the trust of the people, and it's a political war of all against all. It's not surprising that people don't trust the idea of mass surveillance, even if it is supposedly going to be directed against crime. We could stop crime now, but it's a failure of will not mass surveillance. More importantly, many Americans don't feel like the government is even on their side. And Thomas Corbett-Dillon joins to discuss the Lindsay Clancy case, the recent Dominion Society conference in Canada, and where nationalist movements go from here.

item.title: Identity Politics (Ep. 162): The New Reconstruction (w/ Lucy White)
item.description: The last Confederate statues have been brought down in Richmond, VA, the culmination of a decade-long process. "Woke" isn't over, it's triumphant, because it's been institutionalized. Rural white America must be organized but the GOP leadership wants no part of it. If we don't do it, no one else will. Plus Lucy White of the White Papers Policy Institute joins to speak on Remigration, the Save Europe Act, and the heroic efforts of the Dominion Society to host its conference in Canada against state opposition.

item.title: Identity Politics (Ep. 161): “Reparations” Are Just Tribute (livestream replay)
item.description: Reparations are going mainstream and will almost certainly be part of the Democrat platform very soon. Conservatives will roll over for it once the proposal no longer seems "radical." For it to be stopped, you have to change the moral case. Whites aren't the ones who need to pay reparations - we are the ones who are owed.

item.title: MK-Ultra, Gladio & NATO: The Secret Operations Behind the Shadow State
item.description: In this episode of Off The Record with Elizabeth Lane, we take a deep dive into the history of MK-Ultra, Operation Gladio, NATO-linked covert networks, and the secret operations that shaped some of the most controversial chapters of the Cold War. Elizabeth is joined by Jason Shurka, Ron James of MUFON, researcher Mark Hanalla and former CIA Kevin Ship as we examine the documented history of MK-Ultra and Gladio, along with claims that psychological operations, behavioral experimentation, intelligence networks, and methods of social influence may have continued in different forms and moved into new technological domains.

item.title: Identity Politics (Ep. 160): The Izzat of America (w/ Amanda Milius)
item.description: The Trump Administration is cracking down on both legal and illegal immigration, though it may not be enough. Still, it's too much for those dependent on H1-B visas, who are screaming abuse at Americans. Confronted by people who understand only strength in response to their scams, it's time to shut down this racket once and for all for the honor of America. Plus, Amanda Milius, director and producer of The Plot Against The President, joins for a wide-ranging discussion on wealthy conservatives' refusal to patronize artists, where filmmaking stands today, stories from her father's colorful career, and what the future holds for her own work.

item.title: Identity Politics (Ep. 159): Real Populism Requires Patrons (w/ Dalton Clodfelter)
item.description: Data Centers have unexpectedly emerged as a key issue in the midterm elections, threatening the GOP's hold on rural America. Conspiracy theories and utter nonsense have proliferated, but this hides a deeper truth - red America has no reason to trust Big Tech. And Big Tech's contempt for rural white America is such that they aren't even trying to win them over with patronage. Real populism hasn't yet arrived. Plus, Dalton Clodfelter joins to discuss his new book "King or Chaos."

item.title: Identity Politics (Ep. 158): Free Derek Chauvin
item.description: It is apparently conventional wisdom that blacks cannot be held responsible for anything, even murder. Karmelo Anthony is getting a new trial. A professor who exposed Jason Arday has been suspended. And hysteria about non-existent black victims of racism continues. We need to strike at the root, and destroy the myth that launched us into this modern era of wokeness. It's time to tell the truth about George Floyd, and it's time to free Derek Chauvin.

item.title: Identity Politics (Ep. 157): Waiting For The Fall (w/ Stormy Waters)
item.description: Dissident candidates went down to defeat in Florida elections yesterday, a painful reminder that democratic politics (small d) has rules, and you need to play by them if you want to win. There are hard and frustrating lessons to learn for people who want to participate in the system. What about if you think it's all pointless? Well, trends are in motion that will force the system into a crisis, most likely driven by financial factors. That and generational change will open up new paths for action - but only if we prepare now. And Stormy Waters joins for a wide ranging discussion on the nature of the global financial system.

item.title: Identity Politics (Ep. 156): No Pity, No Remorse (w/ Nick (Night Nation))
item.description: Jason Arday has committed suicide, and academics and journalists are using this as a reason to campaign for more censorship and more protections for their little guild. But their empathy is deeply selective - there was nothing for Professor Mike Adams, Jake Gardner, J6 Defendants and others who committed suicide after media incitement. Empathy is always selective; the constant is that they always want more power over you. Plus, Nick from NightNation.Live joins us to discuss the End of White Flight.

item.title: Identity Politics (Ep. 155): The Next Great White Defendants
item.description: A black teen, Nolan Wells, went out with his white friends for the Fourth of July; he didn't come back. Naturally, many online have decided this must have been murder, and people have already been arrested for making violent threats. Al Sharpton, Ben Crump, and the Black Congressional Caucus are already involved; his friends are protesting their innocence. Anything is possible... but this looks like another example of blacks' racial paranoia, where they really believe that widespread lynchings, "sundown towns," and racist death squads are lurking behind every bush.

item.title: Identity Politics (Ep. 154): How We Lost Free Speech (w/ Jeremy MacKenzie)
item.description: We didn't lose free speech by accident, or through some organic process. It was taken from us, deliberately, and with staggering speed. We detail an article from "Arctotherium" that breaks down in more detail than ever before how the Internet was closed. It's the biggest cultural change of our lifetime and almost no one even recognizes it happened. Plus, Jeremy MacKenzie from Second Sons joins to discuss his nationalist organization and the battle to save the Great White North.

item.title: Identity Politics (Ep. 153): Woke 2.0 Will Be Worse (w/ Nightmare Vision)
item.description: The anti-white Left is trying to back away from woke, claiming we were all a little nuts in 2020. Well, those of us who kept our heads in that fateful year are not inclined to forgive and forget. And we should be under no illusions that they don’t want to bring it all back as soon as they get the chance. Plus, fellow oldhead Nightmare Vision from Night Owls to discuss the state of the Online Right.
